title: fraxinus oxyphylla var. rostrata
intro: Fraxinus oxyphylla var. rostrata, commonly known as the Manchurian ash, is a deciduous tree species native to East Asia. The Manchurian ash is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are believed to be attributed to its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. Bioactive constituents present in the Manchurian ash include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
